title: CG 단 V-V 귀환 +Δv 인과와 분배기 로딩

numeric_independent.method: Independent pure-Python nodal KCL+VCCS Gaussian elimination solver + closed-form analytical CG feedback equations (without importing mna.js or lab.js evaluate)

verified_flows: predict card answer feedback and dismiss without locking controls
4-beat +Δv causal domino stepping (1..4) highlighting SVG nodes/branches and badges
vin = 0 mV neutral zero-signal handling with exact finite gain (2.67 V/V)
vin = -20 mV reversed polarity (-53.33 mV) and rdiv = 1 kΩ heavy loading (1.78 V/V, +80.0% error)
step 4 click resets sliders back to defaults (vin=+10 mV, rdiv=4 kΩ)
mode switch closed <-> open and theme toggle light <-> dark
mobile 375px right drawer open and Escape close
visual screenshot verification across desktop light/dark and mobile dark

Wrapped multi-step equations inside KaTeX aligned blocks so span.katex-display stays within .formula-box at both 1440px and 375px.
Increased SVG spacing around static box captions ('귀환 분배기 K', '반송 복제 (접지)', '감지 복제 (개방)') and 'vG' in open mode to pass 0.6em label_gaps with 0 defects.
Replaced plain 'kΩ' with fmtOhmsTex inside KaTeX math strings in diagnosis.text.
Moved '(+XX.X%)' into Tile 3 label ('로딩 무시 (+20.0%)') with clean '3.20 V/V' value so mobile 3-column tiles do not wrap '%' onto a third line.
